script:
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\rpiwin\fw | Out-Null
[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12
$base = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RPi-Distro/firmware-nonfree/trixie/debian/added-firmware/brcm/'
foreach ($n in 'brcmfmac43456-sdio.bin','brcmfmac43456-sdio.txt') {
  $dst = "C:\rpiwin\fw\$n"
  Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing "$base$n" -OutFile $dst -TimeoutSec 120
  $f = Get-Item $dst
  "{0}  {1} bytes  sha256={2}" -f $n, $f.Length, (Get-FileHash $dst -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
}
